name: (02) Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 1 Basic — Stigmatize

system.description:
Probing deeper into a victim's psyche, the infernalist strips away their social grace, leaving them detached, antisocial and unable to connect with anyone around them.

Make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of the victim's Mental Traits; on a win they must bid an additional Social Trait on all Social Challenges for the rest of the scene. You may successfully use Stigmatize on a given individual only once per scene, though several infernalists may each apply it to the same target. The power requires line of sight. Retest with Subterfuge.
